name: CJPL-II
notes: Completion date for CJPL-II civil engineering (reported elsewhere as December 2023) was not confirmed on an official page fetched in this session and is therefore not recorded as a sourced interval on the facility.

summary.plain: A newer, larger extension of the Jinping underground laboratory, about half a kilometre from the original hall along the same tunnel, also under more than two kilometres of rock.
summary.technical: CJPL-II: a second-phase extension of CJPL, ~500 m west of CJPL-I along the same traffic tunnel, with four planned caverns (14 m x 14 m x 130 m each) and ~2100 m (2100 m.w.e.) rock overburden; civil engineering credited elsewhere to Tsinghua University and Yalong River Hydropower Development Company (not independently confirmed on an official page in this session).
